$comment: Gate 5 Phase 5 (APR-JE-033). Every external address that appears in the files the demonstration delivers: one clickable link and a few addresses printed as plain text. check:links fails on any external address that is not listed here (a new destination needs a recorded decision) and on an entry that no longer appears. 'link' is an attribute value in markup; 'mention' is text a visitor could read but no page links to. XML namespaces and schema.org identifiers are not destinations and are not listed. A client build adds its own destinations (ordering URL, map, social links) from its configuration; those are verified per client (see EXTERNAL-LINKS-GATE5.md for the proposed release requirement). The mentions inside fonts/LICENSES.txt are the licence texts' own printed addresses, copied from the upstream licences and not edited.
